questions.question: What did Samuel call Israel to do to defeat the Philistines?
options: Make a treaty with the Philistine lords
Put away foreign gods and return to the LORD
Raise a great army from all the tribes
Flee away into the hills until the danger passed
questions.answer: Put away foreign gods and return to the LORD

questions.question: What stone did Samuel set up, naming it Ebenezer ("stone of help")?
options: A boundary marker between two tribes
A memorial of God's help and victory
A throne for the coming king
A gate for the city of Mizpah
questions.answer: A memorial of God's help and victory

questions.question: The LORD thundered against the Philistines, and Israel defeated them.
Samuel set up a stone and called it _____, saying, "Thus far the LORD has helped us."
Samuel told Israel to put away their foreign _____ and serve the LORD only.
